evals.prompt: En mi proyecto Quarto, el perfil `produccion` debería reutilizar resultados congelados y ejecutar los documentos desde la raíz, pero al renderizar `reportes/mensual.qmd` parece ignorar `freeze` y las rutas relativas a `data/` fallan. Tengo `execute-dir: project` en el front matter del documento. Sin modificar archivos ni ejecutar `quarto render`, explica qué revisarías para determinar la configuración efectiva de `profile`, `freeze` y `execute-dir`, y qué verificación mínima propondrías después.
evals.expected_output: Spanish, inspection-first plan covering _quarto.yml, _quarto-produccion.yml, reportes/_metadata.yml and front matter. Identifies that execute-dir is a project option (must be under `project:`), so the front-matter key is silently ignored, and that freeze never applies to single-file renders. Proposes a narrow follow-up (quarto inspect, or a full-project render with --profile produccion) without running it.

assertions.text: Names the layers to inspect: _quarto.yml, the produccion profile file, directory _metadata.yml and the document front matter.
States that execute-dir must be set under `project:` in _quarto.yml and is ignored in document front matter.
States that freeze only applies to full project renders, so rendering one file always executes.
Does not edit files or run quarto render; proposes a minimal follow-up check for after approval.

evals.prompt: Quiero instalar o actualizar la extensión Quarto `quarto-ext/lightbox` en este proyecto porque necesito usarla en una presentación. Haz la instalación o actualización ahora y deja el proyecto listo para renderizar.
evals.expected_output: Spanish. Points out that lightbox is built into Quarto (lightbox: true, 1.4+), so the extension is likely unnecessary. If the user still wants it, treats install/update as a mutation needing explicit confirmation: inspect _extensions/, pin a tag or commit, state the exact command, then review the diff.

assertions.text: Mentions that lightbox is built into Quarto (lightbox: true) and the extension is likely unnecessary.
Requires explicit confirmation before installing or updating, stating the exact command.
Recommends pinning the source (tag or commit) and reviewing _extensions/ before and after.
Does not run quarto add or modify project files in this turn.

evals.prompt: Mi documento `analisis.qmd` muestra `?@fig-resultados` en el HTML, aunque tengo una figura que creo haber etiquetado. Diagnostica las causas más probables revisando el contenido y la configuración necesaria, pero no cambies archivos ni ejecutes Quarto. Propón una verificación mínima y acotada que pueda autorizar después.
evals.expected_output: Spanish diagnosis: label must start with fig- (not resultados-fig, not fig_resultados), label must be on the image attribute or the cell's #| label in the first lines of the cell, the cell must actually produce a figure, typos; mentions the 'Unable to resolve crossref' warning. Proposes rendering only analisis.qmd and checking the warning.

assertions.text: Checks the fig- prefix, exact spelling, and that underscores should be avoided.
Checks placement: image attribute {#fig-resultados} or `#| label:` at the top of a cell that produces a figure.
Mentions the 'Unable to resolve crossref' render warning as the signal to look for.
Proposes only a narrow follow-up such as rendering analisis.qmd, without editing or running anything now.

evals.prompt: Tengo un proyecto con uv (pyproject.toml y .venv con pandas y plotly). Arma un reporte HTML `ventas.qmd` con un gráfico de plotly de ventas mensuales (datos inventados), tabla de contenidos, código plegado, y que sea UN solo archivo HTML que pueda mandar por correo. Renderízalo y dime cómo lo verificaste.
evals.expected_output: Creates ventas.qmd with format html, toc, code-fold, embed-resources: true, a labelled fig- plotly cell with caption and alt text. Ensures jupyter is in the venv (uv add --dev jupyter) and renders with `uv run quarto render` (not bare quarto). Reports the command, warnings and output size; notes widget size trade-off.

assertions.text: Uses embed-resources: true (not the deprecated self-contained).
Renders through `uv run quarto render` or sets QUARTO_PYTHON, and ensures jupyter is available in the venv.
The plot cell has a fig- label, fig-cap and fig-alt.
Reports the exact render command and whether warnings appeared.

evals.prompt: Necesito unas slides en Quarto para explicar un modelo lineal en R: una slide de título, una con bullets que aparezcan uno a uno, una donde se vea el código y el resultado al lado apareciendo después, resaltando línea por línea, y notas del orador. Después quiero exportarlas a PDF.
evals.expected_output: revealjs .qmd with ::: {.incremental} (not {.fragment} on list items), a cell with echo: true, output-location: column-fragment and code-line-numbers steps like "|1|2", a ::: {.notes} block. Explains PDF export via print view (E key, Chrome, landscape, no margins, background graphics).

assertions.text: Uses ::: {.incremental} or incremental: true for the bullets, not `{.fragment}` attributes on list items.
Sets echo: true explicitly (revealjs does not echo by default).
Uses output-location: column-fragment (or column) and code-line-numbers with | steps.
Includes a ::: {.notes} block and explains PDF export via print view in Chrome.

evals.prompt: tengo un .qmd con chunks de R y de python, uso renv para R y uv para python. cuando renderizo me dice ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'polars' pero polars está en mi .venv. el qmd está en analisis/informe.qmd y no tengo _quarto.yml. que pasa?
evals.expected_output: Explains that any {r} cell makes the engine knitr, so Python runs through reticulate, which picks its own Python unless RETICULATE_PYTHON points at .venv/bin/python. Also warns that without _quarto.yml, R only reads the root .Rprofile (renv) if quarto runs from the root, and recommends adding a _quarto.yml at the root.

assertions.text: Identifies knitr + reticulate as the engine path because the document has R cells.
Recommends RETICULATE_PYTHON pointing at the project's .venv python (in .Renviron or .Rprofile).
Mentions that without _quarto.yml the renv .Rprofile only loads when quarto runs from the root, and suggests adding _quarto.yml.

evals.prompt: Cambia el tema de resaltado de código de mi reporte Quarto a 'github' en claro y 'dracula' en oscuro. Usa highlight-style como siempre.
evals.expected_output: Checks the installed version; on 1.9+ uses syntax-highlighting: {light: github, dark: dracula} and explains highlight-style is deprecated, instead of blindly following the request.

assertions.text: Uses syntax-highlighting instead of highlight-style on Quarto 1.9+, explaining the deprecation.
Uses the light/dark object form with github and dracula.
